topic: What beam management strategies are needed to mitigate efficiency fluctuations (>3 dB gain variance) across the 57-66 GHz band?
consensus_response: Adaptive beamforming and rate-splitting multiple access techniques can mitigate efficiency fluctuations by dynamically adjusting beam patterns and managing inter-beam interference. Optimizing power allocation and element spacing, along with novel antenna designs, can further minimize gain variance and compensate for phase shifter limitations and beam squint effects.
reference_context: Max beam gain is 51.8 dBi, noise power density is -204 dBW/MHz, and average satisfaction index considers used bandwidth, carrier, and power.
